candidates.old:
LDA straight_sprite_hi,X
    BNE known
    RTS                             \ an unused table entry
.known
    STA col_ptr + 1
    LDA straight_sprite_lo,X
    STA col_ptr
    LDA sprite_column_count,X
    STA ds_c                        \ columns left
    STA ds_n
    STZ ds_clip                     \ 65C02 opcode: whether any column can be clipped: not if
    LDX dm_jmin                     \ jmin is 0 and jmax n - 1 or more (X: the sprite, done with)
    BNE clips
    CMP dm_jmax                     \ A = n: no clip if n <= jmax
    BCC no_clip
    BEQ no_clip
.clips
    DEC ds_clip                     \ &FF
.no_clip
    LDA dm_scr_lo                   \ the part's bottom, raised once
    LDX dm_scr_hi                   \ Y: still the rows it is raised
    JSR raise_address
    STA b_ptr                       \ the cell (its line cleared below)
    AND #&07
    STA ds_line
    TRB b_ptr                       \ 65C02 opcode: b_ptr AND &F8
    STX b_ptr + 1
    LDA ds_clip                     \ step 2 layer 4: a part that cannot be clipped may be one of
    BNE generic                     \ the player's kinds compiled to code (tools/compiled.py), or
    LDA dm_slot                     \ a big part's kind built at run time (src/kindcache.6502,
candidates.new:
LDA straight_sprite_hi,X
    BNE known
    RTS                             \ an unused table entry
.rds_clip_g32                       \ out of line, reached by branch only: a part that can be clipped
    LDA #&FF
    STA ds_clip                     \ &FF
    BRA generic
.known
    STA col_ptr + 1
    LDA straight_sprite_lo,X
    STA col_ptr
    LDA sprite_column_count,X
    STA ds_c                        \ columns left
    STA ds_n
    LDA dm_scr_lo                   \ the part's bottom, raised once
    LDX dm_scr_hi                   \ Y: the rows it is raised; none for a mover's first part
    CPY #0                          \ (the commonest: nothing to raise, A and X are the answer)
    BEQ rds_flat_g32
    JSR raise_address
.rds_flat_g32
    STA b_ptr                       \ the cell (its line cleared below)
    AND #&07
    STA ds_line
    TRB b_ptr                       \ 65C02 opcode: b_ptr AND &F8
    STX b_ptr + 1
    LDA dm_jmin                     \ whether any column can be clipped: not if jmin is 0 and
    BNE rds_clip_g32                \ jmax n - 1 or more (decided here, with A free, so that the
    LDA dm_jmax                     \ unclipped part, the common one, goes on with no flag to
    CMP ds_n                        \ reload: C set if n <= jmax)
    BCC rds_clip_g32
    STZ ds_clip                     \ 65C02 opcode: 0; step 2 layer 4: a part that cannot be clipped may be one of
    LDA dm_slot                     \ the player's kinds compiled to code (tools/compiled.py), or a big part's kind built at run time (src/kindcache.6502,
candidates.summary: ren_draw_sprite: (1) a part with no rows to raise (Y = 0: every mover's first part, 44% of calls, exactly the calls that take raise_address's fast path) skips JSR raise_address with CPY #0 / BEQ, since for Y = 0 it returns A = lo, X = hi unchanged; 32 cycles a call for 5. (2) The clip decision moves after the address work, where A is free: LDA dm_jmin / BNE / LDA dm_jmax / CMP ds_n / BCC, then STZ ds_clip falls straight into LDA dm_slot, so the unclipped part (the common one) loses the early STZ/LDX/BNE/CMP/BCC (14) and the LDA ds_clip / BNE generic (5) for 16 in all; the clipped part sets ds_clip = &FF and BRA generic from a 6-byte block placed after the unused-entry RTS (the hot path never falls into it). 4 bytes larger (61 for 57). Measured in a private copy on the bench build (unshifted DEBUG_LIVES, pcprof work a pass, 2026-10-22): seed 1 34457 -> 34415 (-42), RIGHT 39690 -> 39640 (-50); passlock state+screen seeds 1 and 3, 3000 passes, identical; ship, release, SKY_HELI=0, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW, gameplay builds all assemble. Alternative to the next two candidates (overlaps both).
candidates.equivalence: Y = 0: raise_address with rows 0 (CMP #0 never takes BCC) returns A = dm_scr_lo - 0 (C = 1 from the CMP), X untouched (STX ra_hi is only on its up path), Y untouched; the new path has A = dm_scr_lo, X = dm_scr_hi, Y = 0. Its only other effects are the self-modified operands lo_imm and rows_imm and the scratch ra_lo/ra_hi, which nothing outside raise_address reads (grep). C/Z/N/V after it are not read before the next STA b_ptr / AND #7 (V is not read anywhere on the way; compiled_part's first flag use is its own ASL). Y != 0: the same JSR with the same A, X, Y; only CPY #0 (C, Z, N) is added. Clip: the old test (jmin = 0 and n <= jmax, unsigned, n = ds_n = the A the old code compared) is the same test made after raise_address, which touches only A, X, Y, b_ptr's inputs, lo_imm, rows_imm, ra_lo, ra_hi, none of dm_jmin, dm_jmax, ds_n; LDA dm_jmax / CMP ds_n gives C = (jmax >= n) = old BCC/BEQ no_clip. ds_clip is written on both paths before anything reads it: the only reader is draw_column's BIT ds_clip (reached only through generic); the compiled and kind-cache paths never read it, and every path to generic has ds_clip written (clipped: &FF by the block, A = &FF at generic as the old LDA ds_clip left it; unclipped: STZ, the same 0 as before). Registers at LDA dm_slot: A set by it, X = hi and Y as before, so the compiled_part / kc_part / generic paths see what they saw (C differs: set by the CMP; compiled_part starts with ASL A / ROL A, the kind-cache path with CMP, generic with BIT dm_flip, none reads the entry C). No entry past a label (grep ren_draw_sprite and known, clips, no_clip: all local to the routine); the old labels clips and no_clip go; BRA generic from the out-of-line block is within range (assembled in every build).
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings: the window stays in page &9B in the bench build and the table reads (straight_sprite_hi/lo, sprite_column_count) are unmoved; the +4 bytes slide everything after the window in render.6502 (generic, draw_column and on) up by 4 in bank 4. Measured on the bench build the slide cost nothing (render a pass fell by the 44 the change should save), but the shipping build's layout was not measured. Assumes lo_imm, rows_imm, ra_lo, ra_hi are read only inside raise_address (grep found no other reader), and that BIT ds_clip in draw_column is the only reader of ds_clip. Needs ds_n = the sprite_column_count (stored in the window just before).

candidates.summary: Only the Y = 0 skip of the first candidate: a part with no rows to raise (Y = 0, every mover's first part, 44% of calls) jumps over JSR raise_address with CPY #0 / BEQ, saving the JSR and raise_address's whole fast path (6 + 26 cycles) for 5; the other calls pay 4 more. 4 bytes larger. Measured in a private copy on the bench build: seed 1 34457 -> 34425 (-32), RIGHT 39690 -> 39656 (-34). Alternative to the first (which includes it) and the third (overlap).
candidates.equivalence: For Y = 0 raise_address returns A = lo, X = hi, Y = 0 unchanged (CMP #0 sets C, BCC not taken, SBC of 0 with C = 1); the skip leaves the same A, X, Y. The operands lo_imm, rows_imm and ra_lo/ra_hi it would have written are read only inside raise_address (grep). Flags after: the next instruction is STA b_ptr, then AND #&07 sets N, Z; C and V are not read before being rewritten. Y != 0: the same JSR with the same registers.
candidates.relies_on: Slides everything after it in render.6502 by 4 bytes (measured on the bench build, no page-crossing loss: the saving was the full 32/34). Y holds the rows from entry to here (nothing in the routine writes Y before this: only TAX/STX, LDA/STA, LDX, STZ).

candidates.summary: Byte-neutral clip decision only (the first candidate without the Y = 0 skip): the clip test is made after raise_address with A free (LDA dm_jmin / BNE / LDA dm_jmax / CMP ds_n / BCC), the unclipped part does STZ ds_clip and goes straight on to LDA dm_slot, dropping the LDA ds_clip / BNE generic (5) and the early STZ / LDX / CMP / BCC (the common path is 16 cycles for 19); the clipped part sets &FF and BRA generic from a block after the unused-entry RTS. 57 bytes both before and after, so nothing moves. Measured in a private copy on the bench build: seed 1 -11, RIGHT -16 work cycles a pass. Alternative to the first two (overlaps both).
candidates.equivalence: As the first candidate's clip paragraph: the test is the same (jmin = 0 and n <= jmax, unsigned) made after raise_address, which does not touch dm_jmin, dm_jmax or ds_n; ds_clip is stored 0 or &FF on every path before generic, compiled_part or kc_part; A = &FF at generic on the clipped path as before; the unclipped path reaches LDA dm_slot with X = hi and Y unchanged. The entry C at the compiled/kind-cache/generic paths differs (CMP's) and none reads it.
candidates.relies_on: No bytes move (the window is 57 bytes before and after, assembled and checked), so no page crossing changes anywhere. Needs ds_clip's only reader to be draw_column's BIT ds_clip.
